limitations: Language Mismatch: Fine-tuned primarily on C functions from CodeXGLUE; JS/TS/Python predictions rely on cross-lingual representation and are not formally benchmarked.

Scope: Intended as an assistive automated second opinion, not a certification or audit guarantee.
